text:
maria: FYI nightly evals flagged a weird repetition+hallucination pattern on the q8 dyn build of rw-7b-lite. baseline fp16 looks fine. :eyes:
ken: ugh, saw that in the dashboard, entropy for several prompts drops mid-gen and tokens repeat. Any quick repro?
xia: I pulled the failed examples from /evals/nightly/2026-03-19/rw-7b-lite-q8 and ran locally with the same seed — reproduced a 3–8 token loop on ~6% of prompts.
toni: can you paste one example? even a truncated gen helps.
xia: sure:
```
Prompt: "Explain how to tie a bowline knot for a climbing harness."
Generation (truncated): "...loop the rope, pass the end through the loop, tighten. tighten. tighten. tighten. tighten. tighten."
```
maria: that looks like classic KV cache or attention index drift after quantized matmul? but the loop happens after token 40-ish, not right at start.
ken: I compared logits traces between fp16 and q8: q8 shows a sudden spike in max-logit around token 42 and entropy drops from 3.8->1.1. fp16 stays smooth.
toni: any recent changes to the dynamic-quant kernel or packing? I know we switched to aggressive per-channel scaling in PR #4923.
maria: PR #4923 is the suspect — it reduced memory but changed per-channel scale fallback heuristics. @ken did a rollback test?
ken: I rolled the kernel back to v3.1 locally — the loop disappears. With v3.1 the entropy curve matches fp16.
qa-bot: nightly-eval run 2026-03-19 id=ne-18475 flagged 84 failing prompts for rw-7b-lite-q8, failure rate 6.2% (+4.7% vs prev). Link: https://ci.redwood/evals/ne-18475
xia: also saw a handful of mild hallucinations (made-up step names) in technical prompts, probably due to token collapse.
toni: mitigation options: revert PR, add per-layer clamp, or fallback to int4 for affected layers. Re-running large sweep will take us ~6 hours.
maria: for triage can we (1) add a quick unit test that compares entropy trajectories fp16 vs q8 for a bunch of prompts, (2) rerun nightly with kernel v3.1 pinned for rw-7b-lite-q8, (3) collect kv-caches and logits for failing cases.
ken: on it — starting a pinned run now, will upload kv+logits to /tmp/logs/q8-kv-dump-184750.
toni: I'll open a rollback PR for the kernel change and link perf impact numbers. We should also tag the eval failures in the rollout dashboard to pause canary.
maria: good. if rollback fixes it, let's coordinate with infra to push a patch to Dedicated and Hosted canaries. @xia can you start the per-prompt entropy test?
xia: yes, kicking off a 200-prompt run now. ETA ~45m.
ken: uploaded initial kv/logit tar to s3://redwood-dev/triage/q8-184750.tgz (contains traces and seed mapping).
qa-bot: Note: document in incubation board (INC-312) to track this regression to resolution.
maria: Thanks. tagging postmortem owners: @ken, @toni, @xia. I'll update the incident thread if rollback goes to canary. :thumbsup:
toni: looped in @platform-team for fast canary rollback path.
ken: quick note — fallback int4 didn’t reproduce loops in a quick check, but quality is worse overall. so not ideal long-term.
xia: adding a couple failing prompts to nightly regression set so we catch future regressions earlier.
maria: OK holding actions: pause q8 rollout, pin kernel v3.1 in CI, run entropy test, collect artifacts, and draft rollback PR. We'll reconvene after the pinned run finishes.
